title: CLI Tools
subtitle: Command-line utilities for managing, validating, and auto-translating your i18n files.

installation.title: Installation
installation.desc: Add the CLI as a dev dependency to use the short npx ats command — just like npx ng with Angular CLI.
installation.run_desc: Then run any command with npx ats <command>, pnpx ats <command>, or bunx ats <command>. Install globally with npm install -g to use the bare ats command everywhere.

generate.desc: Generates TypeScript interfaces from your JSON translation files and registers them with @angular-translation-service/core, providing compile-time type safety for service keys and select() namespace schemas.
generate.input_desc: Source directory containing JSON namespace files
generate.check_desc: CI mode: exits with code 1 if types are out of sync

check.desc: Scans your source code (.ts and .html files) for translation key usage and cross-references with JSON files to detect missing and unused keys.
check.src_desc: Source directory to scan for key usage
check.ns_desc: Limit checking to a specific namespace
check.pattern_pipe: 'ns:key' | translate — Angular pipe usage in templates

validate.desc: Compares translation files across all languages to find structural inconsistencies: missing keys, extra keys, and empty values.
validate.input_desc: Root i18n directory containing language subdirectories

clean.desc: Removes orphaned keys from target language files — keys that exist in a translation but no longer exist in the default language.
clean.dry_run_desc: Show what would be removed without modifying files

translate.desc: Uses a local LLM (via Ollama) to automatically translate missing keys from the default language to a target language. Supports batch translation with per-key fallback.
translate.auto_accept_desc: Skip interactive confirmation, accept all translations
translate.feature_batch: Batch translation (35 entries per LLM call for optimal context)
translate.feature_fallback: Automatic per-key fallback when batch parsing fails
translate.feature_placeholders: Preserves interpolation placeholders and documents {name} / {count} as the canonical form; existing {{name}} placeholders remain compatible.
translate.feature_codefence: Handles code-fenced JSON responses from the LLM

editor.desc: Launches a full-featured translation editor web UI in your browser. Includes a side-by-side key editor, LLM-powered auto-translation via Ollama, per-key source code usage tracking, progress bars, and add/delete key support.
editor.input_desc: i18n source directory (auto-discovers from angular.json or convention)
editor.src_desc: Source code directory for scanning key usage
editor.port_desc: Port to serve the editor on
editor.feature_picker: Source and target language picker with side-by-side editing
editor.feature_llm: Real-time LLM translation via Ollama with SSE streaming
editor.feature_badges: Per-key source code usage badges (shows where each key is referenced)
editor.feature_progress: Translation progress tracking per language and namespace
editor.feature_crud: Add, delete, and search keys across all namespaces
editor.feature_validation: Structural validation directly in the UI
editor.feature_autodiscovery: Auto-discovery of i18n directory from angular.json or common conventions

ci.title: CI Integration
ci.desc: Add translation checks to your CI pipeline to catch issues early.

mcp.desc: Starts a STDIO-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes all translation editor capabilities as tools for AI agents. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and any MCP-compatible client.
mcp.config_desc: Add the following to your MCP config file (mcp_config.json, .cursor/mcp.json, claude_desktop_config.json, etc.):
mcp.feature_stdio: STDIO transport — works with any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE
mcp.feature_autodiscovery: Auto-discovers i18n directory and project configuration
mcp.feature_batch: Batch translation with automatic batching and per-key fallback
mcp.feature_scan: Template scanning for hardcoded strings with scored candidates
